title: Authority to Bill a Late Fee on a ShieldCare Instalment Plan
content:
## When a late fee falls due

A late fee falls due on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan whose premium instalments have run past
grace. The fee is billed against the first day of the oldest premium period standing unpaid on the plan,
whichever later periods the fee is worked out over. The entry raises the premium the customer still owes
on that plan by the amount billed, and the customer sees the fee on the plan's premium history and on
the next statement of what is owed.

## Recording the entry

The fee is recorded with `bill_premium_late_fee_5ae6a6af`. This is a care desk tool that is not open by
default: it is unlocked and then called by the agent handling the plan. One call books a single late-fee
entry against the named plan for the unpaid premium period given, and raises the premium outstanding on
that plan by the same amount, so the plan's figure and its history agree straight away.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `plan_id` | An identifier: the reference number of the ShieldCare protection plan the fee is billed on, read from the plan record retrieved for this customer. |
| `late_fee_amount` | A fixed-format money amount: the fee being billed, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the cent when a longer figure is passed. There is no empty value, and a fee of nothing is not booked at all. |
| `period_start` | A fixed-format date: the first day of the unpaid premium period the fee is billed against, written as YYYY-MM-DD in the retailer's own local calendar with no time part. There is no empty value. |
| `channel` | An enumerated value: where the fee was raised from, one of `store`, a branch counter with the customer present; `web`, the customer's online account pages; `phone`, a care representative on a telephone call; `mobile_app`, the retailer's mobile application; `business_desk`, the business sales desk for a business profile. |

## What comes back

A single confirmation sentence in plain text. It names the reference of the new late-fee entry, a string
beginning pfe_, the plan it was booked on, the amount billed in USD to two decimal places, and the
premium now outstanding on the plan in USD to two decimal places. A sentence beginning "Late fee booked"
means the entry was written and the plan's outstanding premium was raised.
